Menora Mivtachim Holdings Ltd who had been investing in Nice Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $5.34 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:NICE) has risen 16.65% since January 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 0.05% the S&P500.
